pool.text: The coastline was occupied by Russia as a result of the Russo-Circassian War.
Provision of weapons to the Circassians caused a diplomatic conflict between empires over Vixen.
The fort of Alexandria was founded at the mouth of the Sochi River.
The last battle of the Russo-Circassian War took place at Qbaada.
The Sochi Lighthouse was constructed in the month of February.
The Dakhovsky Posad was renamed Sochi Posad and incorporated into the Black Sea Governorate.
The first resort named Kavkazskaya Riviera opened in Sochi.
Sochi was granted town status by the authorities.
A hybrid citrus tree named Tree of Friendship was planted in a garden.
Soviet officials decided to expand the city limits by forming Greater Sochi.
The International Olympic Committee announced Sochi had been selected as a finalist city.
Sochi was announced as the host city of the Winter Games.
A mosque was built by United Arab Emirates in the central area of Bytkha.
The Silk Way Rally which is part of Dakar series took place in Sochi.
Sochi topped the rating of thirty best cities for business in Russia.
Sochi hosted the XXII Olympic Winter Games and XI Paralympic Winter Games.
Sochi was one of the host cities for the FIFA World Cup.
An area in the Imereti Lowlands was separated to form Sirius.
Sochi hosted the Formula 1 Russian Grand Prix until this year.
There were two earthquakes in Sochi on January eleventh.
